basic_info.name: Denis Targansky
basic_info.description:
I’m a Senior Software Developer specializing in cloud-native, backend-focused systems built with Java and AWS. I have over 7 years of experience designing and scaling secure, high-availability applications in fintech environments, with a strong focus on API architecture, distributed systems, and system reliability. My work has supported platforms serving thousands of daily users, where performance, uptime, and security are critical.

I’ve led the development of new system modules, modernized legacy applications into more maintainable architectures, and improved system performance through concurrency, observability, and deployment optimizations. I’m also experienced in mentoring developers and leading cross-functional initiatives across fully remote teams, helping align technical solutions with business goals.

Outside of work, I enjoy volleyball, tabletop gaming (especially Dungeons & Dragons), and 3D printing, where I like experimenting with new ideas and technologies. I’m naturally curious and continuously learning, always looking for better ways to build scalable, efficient, and future-ready systems.

experience.title: Senior Software Developer
points: Architected and built extensible RESTful APIs supporting web, mobile, and third-party integrations, eliminating rework and saving 4–6 weeks of future development across multiple feature expansions.
Led development of all newly introduced system modules, transitioning legacy monolithic components toward modular, maintainable architecture.
Refactored synchronous third-party API execution to asynchronous, multi-threaded processing, reducing user-blocking operations by ~80% and improving transaction throughput by ~35%.
Improved deployment workflows, reducing downtime from 30+ minutes to 2–5 minutes through automated pre-update validation and safer rollout practices.
Implemented structured logging and centralized AWS CloudWatch monitoring with proactive memory alerts and thread diagnostics, improving uptime to ~99.95%.
Developed selective hot-fix methodology enabling component-level patching, reducing incident resolution time by ~40%.
Remediated 100+ security vulnerabilities using Snyk, upgrading or replacing unsupported dependencies while maintaining SOC 2 compliance.
Served as senior escalation point for complex production issues, conducting deep SQL and concurrency debugging.

Mentored and onboarded 5+ junior and intermediate developers, improving code review turnaround by 30%, and increasing overall team delivery velocity through established coding standards and architectural guidance.
Led cross-functional initiatives across fully remote teams, aligning product, operations, and engineering stakeholders across multiple time zones, reducing requirement-related rework by ~35%.

experience.title: Software Developer
points: Modernized legacy Java applications using updated architecture patterns and Vaadin frameworks, improving maintainability and extending system lifecycle.
Designed and implemented scalable data ingestion pipelines using AWS SQS and API-driven integrations, reducing manual reconciliation errors by ~30%.
Built a flexible data-merging framework preserving auditability and regulatory integrity during customer migrations.
Optimized web session memory management, preventing infrastructure upscaling and reducing projected AWS memory costs by ~20%.
Collaborated directly with product and operations stakeholders to translate complex financial and regulatory requirements into scalable solutions.

experience.title: Lead Software Developer
points: Designed and developed full-stack web application using C#, ASP.NET Core, MSSQL, and JavaScript.
Translated business requirements into technical architecture and delivery plans.
Accelerated development cycles through structured Agile implementation.
